limitations: The current corpus supports a rule-first/hybrid engineering design, not a clinical accuracy claim.
Several publisher pages expose abstracts rather than full text; claims are limited accordingly.
The 2025 back-acupoint paper uses DMD-BAK and is evidence for a hybrid architecture, not an independent medical gold standard.
